usage_description: EvtxECmd is used for parsing Windows event logs (.evtx files) which can provide valuable forensic artifacts such as program execution, NTFS file system changes, RDP sessions, account lockouts, and more.

suspicious_indicators.pattern: Event ID 4625: An event log entry was suppressed due to duplicate events within a specified time period.
suspicious_indicators.description: This can indicate potential data loss or suppression of critical security events.

suspicious_indicators.pattern: Event ID 4720: A user account was logged off, which may be indicative of unauthorized access or account compromise.
suspicious_indicators.description: This event can help in identifying suspicious activities related to user sessions.

references.title: Enhancing Event Log Analysis with EvtxEcmd using KAPE
